marginalia.note: Concubinatus inprimis Cleri; Clemangis, Iohannis Chevaminum Imperii, Alberti, Bavaria Ducis, Espencei confessionibus probatur, periculum legis & votorum celibatus clarissimè arguit.

page.notes: Left margin notes are small italic and were placed beside the opening lines of the section XXVII; their exact line alignment is approximate. The line "tàm frequentes inter clericos sint scortationes" is overprinted by show-through and partly unreadable; the word "scortationes" is doubtful. The last line "lud," is the end of "illud," split across the line end.
